|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 6) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Coruscant: Night Club (ALT) (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-coruscantnightclub_ai-2021-02-18-2.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-coruscantnightclub_ai-2021-02-18-2-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-coruscantnightclub_ai-2021-02-18.png]], 18 February 2021) → [[File:V0-L-coruscantnightclub_ai-2021-02-18-2-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-coruscantnightclub_ai-2021-02-18-2.png]], 18 February 2021). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: Night Club (ALT)]]): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-coruscantnightclub_a91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Cantina (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-coruscantnightclub_ae1a6ab9">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e1a6ab973f90c7e27c46017e1cc0b6183821519d commit e1a6ab9] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the same card turned to landscape (rotated a quarter turn, 703×980 → 980×703 pixels) the same day; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Cantina (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Coruscant: Night Club (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-coruscantnightclub_a3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at lower resolution (980×703 → 745×534 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Cantina (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Coruscant: Night Club (ALT) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-coruscantnightclub_a793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the copyright line on the right edge “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the whole card was re-rendered from the PC's high-resolution file (type, icons and picture redrawn); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Cantina (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”
